rules.recommendation: Review the filesystem mount scope before installing; prefer project-local read-only paths.
Do not grant home, root, or system paths to agent tools; mount only the project directory needed.

gemma_review.summary: This local scan found agent-operating-surface signals that deserve review before broad agent automation.
quick_wins: Run read-only before granting write access.
Document which MCP servers and browser profiles are allowed.
Keep secret values out of model context and reports.
hardening_plan: Inventory agent config and instruction files.
Narrow shell, browser, network, and write permissions.
Re-run the scan and compare the risk score before shipping.

profile.name: Filesystem MCP
